description: This file is a Dart class named CartProvider that manages the shopping cart state in a Flutter application. It performs CRUD operations via an API client to load, add, remove, update, and clear cart items, and notifies listeners about state changes.

classes.name: CartProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class in Flutter that manages shopping cart state, interfacing with an API client, and notifying UI components upon data updates.

methods.name: loadCart
methods.description: Loads the current cart state from the API.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart with an optional quantity, updating the cart state.

methods.name: removeFromCart
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart by product ID, updating the cart state.

methods.name: updateQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific product in the cart.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.
